body.p: A long time ago some men who were at play caught a loon. For sport they pulled out nearly all its feathers, leaving only one long feather in each wing, and let it go. In the following winter a great fall of snow set in, and, although the people had stores of walrus-meat buried under stones, they were unable to reach them on account of the depth of the snow. Many died of starvation. This storm was caused by the loon in revenge for the ill treatment it had received.
